excerpts.content:
Not the nicest way to speak 😂 Especially as I never said it was too difficult or too heavy, our main concern is a time crunch considering we only have 2.5 months left until the presentation of the CL in Istanbul in the context of EPF4. 

My concern is, is it worth it to implement now, or should we delay it and use a NIF to a rust lib as we are doing now even though it creates corner cases.

excerpts.author: phklive
excerpts.content: Thanks for the suggestion I will.

excerpts.author: phklive

excerpts.author: phklive
excerpts.content:
We will start by a simple implementation and slowly improve it's performance. 

Even though ( I might be wrong ) but I have the understanding that SSZ wouldn't truly be a bottleneck for the client.
